title: Claude Can Now Control Your Entire Computer (Here's How)
description: Anthropic just gave Claude the ability to control your entire computer. You give it a task and if it doesn't have the right integration, it literally takes over your screen — opening apps, clicking buttons, scrolling through pages like a human sitting at your desk. It can chain tasks together too, so you can say "find that email, pull the data, and drop it in a spreadsheet" and it figures out every step. There's also a feature called Dispatch where you text Claude a task from your phone, walk away, and come back to finished work on your Mac. It asks permission before touching anything and you can stop it at any time. Available for Claude Pro and Max subscribers.
